description: Allowlist for scripts/submit-ecosystem-prs.mjs. Copy to scripts/ecosystem-targets.json (gitignored), set example to false, and list only repositories you maintain. targets stays empty until then. LangChain starters, LlamaIndex starters, and Next.js AI boilerplates are documentation examples of the kind of repository a maintainer might add later. They are not targets. The script does not search GitHub for them. --apply requires GITHUB_TOKEN or GH_TOKEN and is refused for this file.

targetShape.framework: langchain, langgraph, vercel-ai, openai-agents, llamaindex, or mastra
